note: Sibling ACQUISITION to acq-2026-09-19-beckett-bowman-2025-bcp-base/2025-bowman-baseball.csv, now in a SEPARATE directory per the steward's refusal (see directorySplitNote). Covers the bowman-chrome product's own numbering: the flagship 100-card Base Chrome set (#1-100) plus its own Bowman Chrome Prospects insert range BCP-153 through BCP-252 (100 cards) -- the Chrome-treated counterpart to the paper product's BCP-1..150 range staged in the sibling directory. Does NOT include BCP-1 through BCP-152 (the paper-Bowman product's own insert, staged in the sibling directory), per productSetKeys.ts treating bowman and bowman-chrome as parent/child but DISTINCT registered keys -- never folded across, now also physically separated at the directory level.
beckettCardListOnly: Card list only, no print-run column on the plain Base rows; the 5 named Variation parallels (Etched In Glass, Image, Rookie Color Run, Rookie Red RC, Rookie Short Print Image, International Refractor) DO carry a parallel name (no print run) because Beckett's own Variations/Prospects sheets state them explicitly as their own sections -- these are not synthesized, they are the source's stated sections.
masterSheetDuplicateRemoved: This xlsx has a 'Topps Master Checklist' sheet that duplicates rows already captured under their properly-cased section (e.g. 'BASE CARDS' duplicating 'Base>Base Set', 'CARDS CHROME ROOKIE RED RC VARIATION' duplicating 'Rookie Red RC Variation', 'INTERNATIONAL REFRACTOR VARIATION' duplicating the same-named Prospects section, 'ROOKIE COLOR RUN VARIATION' and 'ROOKIE SHORT PRINT IMAGE VARIATION' likewise). convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs's SUPERSET_SHEET regex (`^(master\b|...)`) only matches a sheet name STARTING WITH 'master' and does not match 'Topps Master Checklist' (master mid-string) -- this defect was written up in full (workbook URL, sha256, sheet names, exact regex/line reference) for the coordinator to route to the builder currently in that file; NOT fixed here. Worked around locally in this CSV only, via the masterSheetFilterCommand above: rows whose parallel column is entirely uppercase are dropped as confirmed duplicates of a properly-cased row at the same cardNumber+player. This filter is local to this CSV; convertBeckettChecklistXlsx.cjs itself is unchanged.
